description: Use this when the user was sent the link or the code of an apaxas group and wants to join it. Joins as one of the people nobody has claimed yet or, if they are not listed, under the user's own name, like opening the link in the app. Without a name it does not join, and the reply says who is free. It cannot join as someone who is already in the group. Do not use it for a group the user is already in, or to start a new one.

grupo.description: The group link (apaxas.com/k7m2qx9pr4tb), the message that brings it or its code, the end of the link. The group's name does not work here.

tu_nombre.description: Who the user is in the group: one of the free names, or their own if they are not listed.
